item.title: The Kia EV2 looks like a perfect fit as an affordable electric hot hatch, but there’s a catch
item.description: Is the EV2 GT the affordable electric hot hatch we’ve been waiting for? Kia hinted that one is on the way, but it might look and feel a little different from Kia’s other electric GT models. more…

item.title: Bluetti New Year power station sale with up to 53% discounts + exclusive savings from $119, Tenways CGO600 Pro e-bikes $1,599, more
item.description: This week’s starting Green Deals are headlined by the Bluetti New Year power station sale with up to 53% discounts alongside exclusive bonus savings starting from $119, with options like the new Elite 400 Portable Power Station back at its $1,221 low, among many others. There’s also Tenways’ switched-up New Year Sale that is now offering the CGO600 Pro Commuter e-bikes (belt or chain drives) with FREE $118 bundles at $1,599 – plus, the option to score a 180Wh range extender power bank at 50% off

item.title: This crazy-looking EV has Hyundai and German engineering
item.description: It’s not a Hyundai, BMW, or Rimac, but it uses components from all three. Ceer is a new EV brand, and its first vehicle was just spotted out in public with a design that’s… unique, to say the least. more…

item.title: Tesla launches US-made solar panel, a rare sign of life for its solar business
item.description: Tesla has updated its online configurator with a new solar panel heavily emphasizing its US manufacturing at Gigafactory New York. It’s a surprising new product launch for a business that Tesla has seemingly been dismantling for the last two years. more…

item.title: Tesla’s Superchargers are no longer just a Tesla thing
item.description: DC fast-charging infrastructure company Francis Energy has signed up for Tesla’s Supercharger for Business program, and its first site, located in Oklahoma, is set to officially launch tomorrow. more…

item.title: The Genesis GV90 is shaping up to be an ultra-luxe tech powerhouse
item.description: Genesis is rolling out new digital tech for its flagship vehicles. The full-size GV90 is set to debut any day now as the first vehicle to feature Hyundai’s new Pleos infotainment system. more…

item.title: US offshore wind backlash grows as Empire, Revolution Wind sue Trump admin [update]
item.description: Two more offshore wind developers are suing the Trump administration after it abruptly ordered construction to stop on offshore wind projects that were already nearing completion – the first ruling is in. more…

item.title: Stellantis kills its plugins, Tesla could back out of Berlin, and leasing vs. buying
item.description: On today’s plug-pulling episode of Quick Charge, Stellantis is pulling the plug on a number of popular plug-in hybrid models from Jeep and Chrysler, while falling sales and ongoing union clashes at Giga Berlin could spell the end of the road for Tesla production in Germany. more…

item.title: Subaru’s US factory is now exporting clean power to itself
item.description: Subaru of Indiana Automotive has new rooftop solar, and it’s producing far more clean electricity than its new factory expansion even needs. more…

item.title: Tesla updates 2026 Model Y with new features, launches tiny third row in the US
item.description: After months of anticipation and a few teasers, Tesla has officially launched the Model Y 7-seater in the US, along with a suite of small new features for the electric SUV. more…
